nodes.title: NCLEX-RN (Nursing Standard Mapping)
nodes.description: Professional Registered Nurse competencies. Management of care, safety and infection control, health promotion, psychosocial integrity, and physiological adaptation.

nodes.title: RYA/MCA Yachtmaster Offshore
nodes.description: Mastery of vessel command. Navigation, tides, collision regulations, and heavy-weather handling. Directly linked to the Blue Commons maritime track.

nodes.title: ServSafe Food Protection Manager
nodes.description: The industry standard for food safety. Preventing cross-contamination, time and temperature control, and regulatory compliance. Essential for community food hubs.

nodes.title: NALA Certified Paralegal (CP Mapping)
nodes.description: Legal knowledge and skills. Substantive law, research, and ethics. Mapping boundary contracts and poly-centric law to professional paralegal duties.

nodes.title: Avid Pro Tools User Certification
nodes.description: Standard for professional audio production. Multi-track recording, MIDI, editing, and mixing. Linked to the Sonic Mesh-Weaving track.
